patch.summary: WebCatalog implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement WebCatalog by mapping current project-management workflows to WebCatalog objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Chrome, Macos, Windows) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Chrome

blocks.heading: WebCatalog day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat WebCatalog setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for core records before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Knowledge workers who want web apps as desktop apps / workspaces before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Chrome and Macos before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Adjacent desktop shell — not a project management or work OS tool
Do not expand seats until the pilot workflow is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Adjacent desktop shell — not a project management or work OS tool

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: No boards, Gantt, automations, or PM reporting

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: No AI assistance centre of gravity

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: WebCatalog plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Basic
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: integrations, desktop workspace · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Pro
lines.description: 7-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate project-management fit before a deep WebCatalog rollout
blocks.body: If WebCatalog fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft WebCatalog object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on primary workflow
If blocked, evaluate monday.com before sunk-cost expansion
